title: Fail closed when Windows Sandbox state is elevation-gated
failure_signature: The ordinary optional-feature query required elevation and the Windows Sandbox executable was absent.
candidate_workaround: Treat elevation-gated Sandbox status as an open environment gap and stop at read-only evidence.
recurrence_guard: Never elevate, enable a feature, weaken security, or reboot to satisfy a validation template.
rollback: Leave the host unchanged and retain the unavailable receipt.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
